pr_title: Fix duplicate shortcut key configuration items in Keyboard shortcuts Window (fix #4387)
pr_body:
This PR is a follow up to https://github.com/aseprite/aseprite/pull/4453

Is this new approach suitable @dacap?

I think _Open Sprite : <filename>_  can be improved but I need your preference on the matter.

I can squash the 4 commits and then push-force if it's better for you.

fix #4387
pr_comments:
Hi there!

One or more of the commit messages in this PR do not match our [code submission policy](https://github.com/aseprite/aseprite/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md), please check the `lint_commits` CI job for more details on which commits were flagged and why.
Please do not close this PR and open another, instead modify your commit message(s) with [git commit --amend](https://docs.github.com/en/pull-requests/committing-changes-to-your-project/creating-and-editing-commits/changing-a-commit-message) and force push those changes to update this PR.
I guess the approach is fine. I'll fix the sugestions of aseprite-bot.

> I guess the approach is fine. I'll fix the sugestions of aseprite-bot.

Fix the comments and then I'll review this PR.

Please don't use "menu" strings on `onGetFriendlyName()`, use `Strings::commands_*` strings (and add new if necessary).

Cherry-picked in aca9bf6bb7a6b2ccd24468f8346af7dd122ec86e + a7a31f9a4acabb20fe44c8af329c36e7656b92a1 and merged squashed first and last commits of this PR in 04c45f4329bc21f2f53104ed3b03519e1f977138 :rocket:  

After that 0a1c5275a76a04bff4d2f132095fa3d007606a3e fixes a problem where commands with a different context must be listed in the keyboard shortcuts (so I've removed the `KeyContext` parameter from `isListed`).

issue_context.title: Duplicate shortcut key configuration items in Keyboard shortcuts Window
issue_context.body: From https://github.com/aseprite/languages/issues/29#issuecomment-1848991843 aseprite version: 1.3.5 The problem still exists. ~~There seems to be some issues with the UI here. The column `action` width is not enough and cannot be adjusted, causing text to be obscured.~~
